host.description: The hostname or IP address of the IBM host to connect to by default.

port.description: The TCP port number for the TN3270 service on the host.

login_id.description: The user ID to send automatically for authentication.

password.description: The password to send automatically for authentication.

terminal_type.description: The emulation type string (e.g., IBM-3270-2, IBM-3287) for the session.

color.description: Enable color support if the remote host and terminal emulator allow it.

transfer_dir.description: The local directory where IND$FILE transfers are saved.

macros.description: A list of file paths to macro scripts to execute on session startup.
